title: The Lantern-Bearing Fox
statement: When the first winter nearly swallowed the world, a small fox stole a single coal from the Moon's own hearth and carried it across the dark sky in her jaws, leaving a trail of sparks that never went out. Find her still: ears pricked, tail curled like a question mark, the lantern-star at her nose burning amber — a reminder that even the smallest light, bravely carried, can outlast the longest night.
